scenarios.method: Bull/bear = Nifty more than 1% above/below the live price on the exit date; sideways = within 1%. Probabilities are the equal-weight average of the four sources shown. Each structure is valued at the exit date with Black-Scholes at every leg's own live implied volatility, entered at live bid/ask, costs removed. 'If scenario' = average P&L over a 1-2% move that way (wider if the implied 1-sigma move is larger). Ranking = probability-weighted P&L per rupee of max loss. Probabilities are not calibrated forecasts.
